subset_462_jobs.selection_rule: Jobs from 1000-job random sample of 3,945 pre-2025 training jobs that qualified for power-model slope estimation (>= 8 fp nodes per job, each with >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid timestamps). TRAIN_SAMPLE_N=1000, seed=42 in r1_m3_thermal_model.py.

full_population.selection_rule: All pre-2025 jobs in globus_batch.txt with at least one fp node having >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid timestamps. No minimum fp-nodes-per-job requirement.

verdict: Full-population p95=63.6250 C vs subset p95=63.6250 C (delta=+0.0000 C). Difference < 0.5 C: subset threshold is a reliable estimate.
